claims.statement: An agent answers an explicit architectural source-dependency question between two known Python modules by recovering one bounded source-qualified import-candidate route, retaining the distinction from runtime dependencies and architectural intent.

attributes.title: Source-qualified architectural routes

alignment.basis: Compounding product knowledge and source-grounded intervention under ADR 0038.

ambition.basis: Enables directed multi-hop inquiry beyond one-file source context without a general inference engine.

horizon.basis: Reuses existing exact-commit source and Python import candidate mechanisms.

realization.basis: Actual run 46099125071 at candidate 107bdeb2 rehearsed its six-path new source-and-knowledge contribution using the canonical co-design command at eaf2f522. The exact candidate then recovered a three-hop import-candidate witness from patch_rehearsal.py via workspace_knowledge.py and source_relationships.py to verification_scenarios.py at the original BASE. All three importer source hashes matched the committed bytes and cited lines were actual import statements. A one-hop bound and the low-level worktree_context.py to patch_rehearsal.py inquiry returned NO_ROUTE_FOUND_WITHIN_BOUNDS. A one-file bound returned NOT_ASSESSED and disclosed its exhausted file budget and five queued paths.

history.basis: Existing context-for provides direct import and importer views; new route inquiry is not yet observed.

disposition_history.authority: agent construction selection within delegated self-development
disposition_history.rationale: Select bounded directed witness rather than general transitive graph, additional goal bridge, or manual-only inspection.

attributes.synthesis_basis: Reuse exact-source Python AST import candidate reading in bounded, explicit directed path search; unique tracked module candidates only, no semantic or runtime graph inference.
attributes.value_hypothesis: An authorized software-development agent can recover a concrete directed source-qualified import-candidate route between two known Python modules to inform an architectural intervention without manually assembling every intermediate source context.
attributes.revisit_when: Actual multi-hop source questions expose a material unsupported resolution case, or file:src/sensemaking_skills/semantic_architecture/source_relationships.py changes.
attributes.counterevidence: Manual source inspection remains viable; static module-name candidates can differ from runtime resolution; bounds and unreadable/ambiguous paths limit absence claims. No independent benefit or efficiency measured.
attributes.claim_ceiling: Observed bounded route inquiry and co-design on one real product intervention; no runtime dependency, global graph completeness, comparative decision quality or independent cognitive benefit.

claims.statement: An authorized software-development agent can recover a concrete directed source-qualified import-candidate route between two known Python modules to inform an architectural intervention without manually assembling every intermediate source context.

value_frame.beneficiary: An authorized agent choosing a source-level architectural intervention involving two known modules.
value_frame.criterion: Recover an actual directed, multi-hop source candidate route with exact revision/path/line evidence, not a general dependency graph or more unqualified context.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Current direct source relationship view and manual recursive import inspection.
value_frame.expected_observation: The actual patch_rehearsal.py to semantic_architecture/verification_scenarios.py question produces a witnessed multi-hop candidate import route at BASE with source hashes and line citations; with hop budget one no such route is observed; the reverse worktree_context.py to patch_rehearsal.py inquiry does not find a route in the bounded static reader. Co-design rehearses actual new code, documentation, pack and supporting report together with separate candidate preflight.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: Witness edges are not source-supported, ambiguity is silently resolved, boundaries are conflated, or later agents find manual inspection preferable.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: A disposable exact-commit checkout and bounded forward parse search; no full graph persistence or new schema. Manual inspection remains viable.
